You can start your return or exchange online here: [Start My Return or Exchange](https://olukai.com/returns) If you have more questions or want details about the process, just let me know!DisclosurePhone support also available for the US at +1 877-789-5131 and for Canada at +1 833-346-0705. Hours are Mon-Fri 8 am to 5 pm PT. We and our service provider may record your chat with us. By using this chat, you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.Agent saidAloha! Thanks for contacting the OluKai Aloha Experience Team. I'm an AI-powered virtual assistant, and can answer questions and also help with order returns and exchanges. How can I help you?You saidHi! For example, are you interested in sandals, shoes, boots, or slippers? And is this for men, women, or kids? Any specific occasion or style you have in mind?You saidI want something for everyday use, good quality, and I care about value for money.Agent saidGreat!
